summary: SL Investment Fund II LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, SLIF II Financing SPV LLC, entered into an Omnibus Amendment dated September 30, 2026 to its October 10, 2024 Loan and Servicing Agreement with UBS AG Stamford Branch, as administrative agent. The amendment raises the facility amount from $600 million to $750 million and lifts the margin rate from 1.90% to 1.95% per annum. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary credit-facility upsize with no change of control, stake, or special-situation mechanics; watch only leverage covenants and Investment Company Act limits.
